label: H.R. 7147
title: Homeland Security and Further Additional Continuing Appropriations Act, 2026.

items.snippet: This bill provides continuing FY2026 appropriations to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) through May 22, 2026.
The bill also authorizes back pay, in accordance with current law, for federal employees who were affected by the partial DHS shutdown.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
